description: Returns the liquidation map of one coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, HYPE or ZEC; default BTC). If cluster_grammar is present, read it first: class=noise (distance <3%) is high-leverage bait to ignore; class=true (~7%+) is the low-leverage stack. The liq_radar block (hypernatt_liq_radar_v2) holds modeled liquidation clusters (zones where leveraged positions may liquidate), observed real_liquidations, open interest (OI) and long/short (L/S) context, and magnet.score (directional density bias from OI, L/S and funding; not a hit probability). USE WHEN an agent needs liquidation terrain for timing or sizing. NOT WHEN it needs order-book depth for a BTC/ETH size (use get_native_depth) or a swap (use swap_via_nattswap). Read-only; terrain, not a trade signal. Price: 0.001 USDC/call via x402 (Base or Solana) or eligible credits.

agent_wallet.description: Optional EVM wallet (0x + 40 hex). Skips x402 when swap-earned quota balance covers this tool's credit weight.

symbol.description: Optional crypto symbol (BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC). Default BTC when omitted.

x_payment.description: Base64 x402 USDC payment. Rails: Base eip155:8453 (EIP-3009) OR Solana SVM exact (@x402/svm; not an EVM signature). Omit on first call to receive 402 accepts[]; retry after paying $0.001/call.

name: get_liq_radar
